initiatives.name: Lavender Fund
initiatives.description: Nonprofit fund that pays for later-pregnancy (all-trimester) abortion care for patients in Washington, DC. Founded in 2023, separate from DuPont Clinic.

initiatives.name: DC Ward 2 Mutual Aid
initiatives.description: Volunteer group in DC's Ward 2 that gives monthly groceries to about 150 low-income immigrant households and weekly supplies to unhoused neighbors.

initiatives.name: SURJ DC
initiatives.description: DC chapter of Showing Up for Racial Justice. Organizes white people to support Black- and POC-led groups in DC, with deep canvassing and migrant justice teams.

initiatives.name: Harriet's Wildest Dreams
initiatives.description: Black-led community defense hub in Southeast DC with organizing, rapid-response, and legal defense programs. Works with DC Mutual Aid Network and Stop Police Terror.

initiatives.name: Stop Police Terror DC
initiatives.description: Works against racist, militarized policing in Washington DC. Campaigns to defund MPD, end stop-and-frisk and fully implement the NEAR Act.

initiatives.name: Family & Friends of Incarcerated People (FFOIP)
initiatives.description: DC nonprofit run by founder Stuart Anderson that runs youth programs and retreats for children of incarcerated people and at-risk teens.

initiatives.name: Beloved Community Incubator
initiatives.description: DC-area nonprofit that helps start and convert worker-owned co-ops, runs the DC SELF solidarity loan fund, and a guaranteed income project.

initiatives.name: Food Not Bombs DC
initiatives.description: Volunteer group that has served free vegan meals to people living outside in downtown DC every Saturday since 2013, made from donated and surplus food. Meals are at McPherson Square.

initiatives.name: Claudia Jones School
initiatives.description: The Claudia Jones School for Political Education is a popular education organization aiming to build the political consciousness of the Washington, D.C. working-class community.

initiatives.name: East of the River Mutual Aid
initiatives.description: Part of DC Mutual Network. Representing ward 7 and 8

initiatives.name: Free Minds Book Club
initiatives.description: DC nonprofit running book clubs and writing workshops for people in the DC Jail and federal prisons, plus a reentry book club and job readiness program for returning members.

initiatives.name: DC IWOC (Incarcerated Workers Organizing Committee
initiatives.description: Resisting the state through an abolitionist inside-outside network, on occupied Piscataway, Manahoac, Appamattuck, Chesapeake & Tutelo lands
